rows.en: －　Corridor　－
＊Amane＊＠０２１＿００１Ahh--!!￥Hey! You there--!
＊Amane＊＠０２１＿００２What do I do...￥What do you think I should do?!
What happened?
Spit it out already!
What happened?
Just tell me already!
＊Amane＊＠０２１＿００３The Environmental Section...￥It's in big trouble!!
＊Amane＊＠０２１＿００４Y-you don't have to get￥so mad about it!!＝＠０２１＿００５If something precious to you was￥in danger, you'd panic too,￥whether you liked it or not!!

＊Amane＊＠０２１＿００６The sunflowers... The sunflowers￥I planted in the Environmental￥Section are about to wither!!＝＠０２１＿００７And they'd only just...￥only just bloomed...＝＠０２１＿００８And that's not all. The other￥plants look sickly too...￥they're starting to droop.＝＠０２１＿００９But why? The control system￥is supposed to be perfect...＝＠０２１＿０１０I want to do something to help￥the sunflowers get better,￥but... I don't know what to do!
Calm down, let's focus.
I'll help you think.
Let's do what we can.
I'll help you think.
＊Amane＊＠０２１＿０１１Huh...?￥O-okay!
＊Amane＊＠０２１＿０１２I've been thinking about it on￥my own this whole time, but... I￥just can't tell what's wrong.
＊Amane＊＠０２１＿０１３But you're right. A time like￥this is exactly when I need to￥stay calm, huh?!
＊Amane＊＠０２１＿０１４Really?!￥Th-thanks...
＊Amane＊＠０２１＿０１５When I'm on my own, I just￥get more and more worked up...
＊Amane＊＠０２１＿０１６I need to calm down a little.
I want to save them too.
How bad is it, exactly?
I want to save them too.
How bad is it, exactly?
＊Amane＊＠０２１＿０１７Yeah, of course! The other￥plants too, but... the￥sunflowers are special, so...
＊Amane＊＠０２１＿０１８Only the sunflowers are dying.￥The others just look a little￥under the weather, but...
＊Amane＊＠０２１＿０１９Sunflowers are a really￥special flower to me.
＊Amane＊＠０２１＿０２０A long time ago, my mom got sick￥and had to go into the￥hospital...
＊Amane＊＠０２１＿０２１I wanted her to get better fast,￥so I went to find sunflowers.￥They're her favorite.
＊Amane＊＠０２１＿０２２When she saw them, she was￥so happy... and after that,￥she started to recover!
＊Amane＊＠０２１＿０２３That's why, to me, sunflowers￥are the flower of happiness!
＊Amane＊＠０２１＿０２４Besides, just looking at those￥big flowers makes you feel￥better, don't you think?
Yeah, I can see that.
You think so?
Yes, I can see that.
Do you think so?
＊Amane＊＠０２１＿０２５Right?! So I wanted to share￥that happy feeling with￥everyone else, too...
＊Amane＊＠０２１＿０２６That's how I feel, anyway...￥but I guess some people￥aren't interested...
＊Amane＊＠０２１＿０２７But there might be people￥who'll come to love them too!!
＊Amane＊＠０２２＿００１That's why I don't want￥them to die!
＊Amane＊...

＊Amane＊＠０２２＿００２I don't want them to die, but￥what could be causing it...＝＠０２２＿００３That place is fully run by￥computer, so I don't think the￥environment is the problem...＝＠０２２＿００４So what...￥what could be going wrong...?
Is the system broken...?
Something we overlooked?
Is the system broken...?
Something we overlooked?
＊Amane＊＠０２２＿００５Oh!!￥Th-that might be it!
＊Amane＊＠０２２＿００６I totally overlooked that... It￥never even crossed my mind...!
＊Amane＊＠０２２＿００７If the control system's broken,￥that would explain everything!
＊Amane＊＠０２２＿００８Something... we overlooked...?
＊Amane＊＠０２２＿００９Oh!! Maybe... what if the￥Environmental Section's control￥system itself is broken...?!
＊Amane＊＠０２２＿０１０I see... So that's why it's not￥just the sunflowers... why all￥the plants were looking sick...
＊Amane＊＠０２２＿０１１If it's a system problem,￥maybe I can actually help!
＊Amane＊＠０２２＿０１２I'm heading to the Environmental￥Section now! I'm sure there's￥something I can do!
＊Amane＊＠０２２＿０１３Thanks for the advice!￥Okay, I'm off--!!
